description: An image painted under ExtGState /SMask /Luminosity — the mask should not end up in the image results as a separate image.

expected.note: 2 images: Im1 (content, outside the group, not masked by itself) + MaskImg (a grayscale image inside beginGroup/Luminosity, which imageRegistry marks as maskEvidence='group'/isMaskLayer=true). Verified empirically: a version of the mask form based on a vector fill alone (without an image) gives ZERO 'image' events inside the group, so the 'group' evidence path would never work.

images.note: the content image (Im1) is not masked by itself; the mask is a separate Luminosity group, which the image pipeline must recognize and skip
